text_sections.label: Special Digivolution Condition
text_sections.text: [App Fusion] [Entermon] & [Fakemon]: Cost 0 If 2 such cards are linked together, stack the link card on top and digivolve

text_sections.label: Effect
text_sections.text: ＜Alliance＞ ＜Link +1＞ (Add 1 to this Digimon's maximum links.) [When Digivolving] [When Attacking] [Once Per Turn] You may play 1 level 4 or lower [Appmon] trait Digimon card from your hand without paying the cost. [All Turns] [Once Per Turn] When any of your Digimon are played, you may link 1 [Appmon] trait Digimon card from this Digimon's digivolution cards to 1 of your Digimon without paying the cost.
